title: For Expressions
scenario: For expressions transform collections without a loop block. Build a list of upper-case names and a map from each name to its upper-case form.
constraints: Use a list for expression with upper(name).
Use a map for expression with name => upper(name).

focus.title: Transform the names
focus.todo: Write list and map for expressions over var.names.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `locals`. Write list and map for expressions over var.names. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `locals`. Use this code shape: upper_names; name_map. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.names`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
